FR-001.title: Offer an isolated optional VibeVoice comparison prototype.

FR-002.title: Allow removal or disabling without changing the existing method.

FR-003.title: Use the same five permitted texts per language across feasible configurations and baseline.

FR-004.title: Support private listening and individual ratings for feasible English and German samples.

FR-005.title: Report individual ratings, averages, and qualitative observations.

FR-006.title: Identify each result’s model, voice, language, machine, and configuration.

FR-007.title: Investigate both model variants and report unavailable or unauthorized implementations.

FR-008.title: Report candidate-machine capacity, platform, requirements, and inspection time.

FR-009.title: Record footprint, peak memory, and generation time or reasons for missing measurements.

FR-010.title: Obtain approval before target-machine downloads, installation, or service changes.

FR-011.title: Document and assess applicable terms before using models, dependencies, voices, or texts.

FR-012.title: Report missing, failed, unsafe, and unavailable comparisons and reasons.

FR-013.title: Keep texts, audio, and results private absent separate publication approval.

FR-015.title: Stop affected runs on failure, cancellation, or agreed resource limits.

expectations: No production deployment, service changes, or automatic fallback
No two-person conversation or broader model search
context: constraint: model, voice, dependency, and sample-text terms must be assessed before use
constraint: preserve existing service and require approval for target-machine changes
intent: Evaluate VibeVoice speech quality and feasibility privately against the existing macOS method using an isolated removable prototype.
